subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Vocabulary and Grammar – Transport verbs; Present simple for the future
outcomes: Name and use 12 transport and travel verbs.
Use the present simple for timetables and fixed plans.
Ask and answer questions about a timetable.

tf.s: When a plane leaves the ground, it takes off.
tf.why: Yes, take off = leave the ground.

tf.s: When a plane comes down to the ground, it lands.
tf.why: Yes, land is the opposite of take off.

tf.s: Take a seat means stand up.
tf.why: Take a seat means sit down.

tf.s: We use the present simple for timetables: The train leaves at 6 o'clock.
tf.why: Yes, timetables use the present simple.

tf.s: What time the train leaves? is a correct question.
tf.why: Say: What time does the train leave?

tf.s: The opposite of get on is get off.
tf.why: Yes, get on the bus, get off the bus.

tf.s: Explore means to stay at home and sleep.
tf.why: Explore means to go and see new places.

tf.s: The flight leave in ten minutes is correct.
Catch a bus means get on a bus before it leaves.
tf.why: Yes, you catch the bus at the bus stop.

tf.s: The present simple can talk about the future when it is a fixed timetable.
tf.why: Yes, like The bus leaves at 7 a.m. tomorrow.

boxes.q: Which verb means 'get to a place at the end of a journey'?
Complete: The flight ___ (leave) in ten minutes.

boxes.why: Get off = leave a bus or train.

boxes.q: Before a trip, you put clothes in your suitcase. You …
boxes.why: Pack = put things in a bag.

boxes.q: Complete: What time ___ the museum open?
Complete: When ___ we arrive in Salalah?
What does a plane do at the end of a flight?

hunt.q: Get to the bus before it leaves

mcq.q: When do we use the present simple for the future?
Which verb is the opposite of take off?
Which is a travel verb from the lesson?
mcq.why: Go on a journey is a travel verb.

mcq.q: Which sentence is about a timetable?
o: I'll help you with your bag.
I'm going to visit my aunt.
I went to Muscat last week.
mcq.why: Times on a timetable use the present simple.

mcq.q: Make a question: the bus / leave / what time?
o: What time does the bus leave?
What time does leave the bus?
What time do the bus leaves?

mcq.q: Travel note: 8 a.m. – leave school. Which sentence is correct?
o: The bus leaves school at 8 a.m.
The bus leave school at 8 a.m.
The bus is leave school at 8 a.m.
The bus leaving school at 8 a.m.

mcq.q: Complete the itinerary: We ___ the museum at 11 a.m.
Correct the mistake: What time the train leaves?
o: What time does the train leave?
What time does the train leaves?
What time is the train leave?
mcq.why: Add does and use the base verb.

mcq.q: The bus leaves at 7 a.m. and arrives in Salalah at 7 p.m. How long is the journey?
mcq.why: From 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. is 12 hours.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the present simple for a future plan correctly?
o: Our flight lands at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
Our flight landed at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
Our flight land at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
Our flight is land at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
